description: Section B.4 of the plan (giao-dien-thiet-ke-jaunty-rain.md): the runtime's sanitizeMessages()/requestInit() must deliver each `lastUserMessage` to backend/src/routers/chat.py byte-identical, because _last_user_text() -> the phrase-matchers in backend/src/session/followups.py decide whether clear_stage_markers() wipes tech_stack.json/blueprint.json/wbs.json. This table is consumed by runtime/src/__tests__/message-integrity.test.ts (Stage 2) -- it asserts requestInit(input).body's messages array contains `lastUserMessage` verbatim for every case, and that `mustNotMatchSubstring` truly does not match the whole-word regex semantics of _matches_whole_phrase (backend/src/session/followups.py:24-33).

cases.label: Vietnamese request mentioning 'docker' -- must NOT match 'doc'
cases.lastUserMessage: vẽ sơ đồ cho hệ thống docker
cases.expectedBranch: _is_pdf_followup -> False (substring 'doc' inside 'docker' must not match the \b-anchored regex)
cases.note: This is the exact false-positive _matches_whole_phrase's docstring warns about: plain substring matching would wrongly flag this as a PDF follow-up and skip clear_stage_markers(), silently reusing a stale tech_stack.json for what is actually a brand new design request.
